background_prompt: An original premium photographic still life about curating a personal photo archive. Deep forest-green textured felt and rich muted green shadows, softly lit warm ivory archival paper and a small open photographic storage box. A few beautiful coastal, botanical and family-life photographs without identifiable people lie naturally at the far lower corners and side edges, including one subtle pair of identical photo prints to suggest sorting. Refined tactile paper edges and warm brass photo-archive details, elegant evening studio light. The central vertical corridor and the entire upper quarter remain calm and dark for a large headline and a device to be composited later. Visually rich and polished at the edges, quiet and coherent behind the typography. No lettering, numbers, logo, text, watermark, phone, tablet, watch, device, screen, UI, digital frame or placeholder. No unrelated kitchen or stationery setup. Full-bleed portrait composition.
